title: Ordinary localization preserves short exact sequences of modules
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, T a multiplicative subset of R, and 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 an exact sequence of R-modules. Using module localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], the sequence 0 \to T^{-1}A \to T^{-1}B \to T^{-1}C \to 0, with maps induced by the given maps, is exact.
